ImageDescription.value: Residential building in Selydove city (Donetsk region of Ukraine) after Russian missile strike in the night on 8 February 2024. According to preliminary data of the police, 8 missiles (S-300 and North Korean KN 23) were launched. One person was killed, 7 were injured. At least 53 apartment buildings and 10 private houses, 4 educational institutions, 2 administrative buildings, a private company and 24 vehicles were damaged (an article).
